prompt: Today it is common practice for many business meetings and business training to take place online. Do the advantages of this new development outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Nowadays, online meetings and training sessions have become popular and common for numerous businesses. In this essay, I will explain why the benefits of this new setting for those activities overshadow the potential drawbacks.

On the one hand, business meetings and training that are conducted virtually can pose challenges. To begin with, this arrangement may lead to distraction, as audiences can have a low focus when they are not in the office or a proper place. For example, Zoom App in today's era make it possible for workers to join the job meeting from a coffee shop that can be less conducive since it is crowded and noisy. Furthermore, this online setting increases the possibility of screen fatigue. As a result of sitting in front of a laptop for a long time during office coordination, people can have a headache or their eyes can turn red and become irritated.

On the other hand, virtual working coordination or training brings some advantages. First and foremost, it will save a lot of cost, since the organiser does not need to pay for the supporting facilities, such as a hall rent, tables and chairs, catering, travel and accommodation. Secondly, this trend development can attract more audiences for a training agenda, since they only need to present virtually. Moreover, it is highly flexible because we can do many tasks at the same time and access the recording once the event is over.

In conclusion, the online setting development brings more advantages than disadvantages. Although people can easily be distracted and experience physical discomfort during the virtual event, it still offers great benefits. By transforming the business agenda to use digital platforms, it can be cost-effective, attract more audiences, and become more flexible.
